text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert PD-8492 fired — CUDA_ALLOC_FAIL spike in us-west2 (gpu-pool-7). 78 errors in 5m. Affected: inference-api-prod. https://pagerduty.example/PD-8492
eric: On-call here, acked PD-8492. Jumping in.
sam: seeing repeated `CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY` in inference logs on node gpu-7-3. KV cache eviction spiking.
  Log snippet: `E cuda_allocator.cc:142] cudaMalloc failed: out of memory`
leo: are the failed requests correlated with long contexts or batch size? any obvious customer impact?
sam: yes — requests with long context (>6k tokens) show elevated 5xx. Metrics: ~2.1% 5xx for model-rw-3b over last 10m (spike).
alyssa: tagging support — customers reported timeouts (ticket SUP-7781). If this goes >5% we need an incident notice.
eric: quick mitigation plan: 1) reduce max_seq to 4096 at routing for rw-3b, 2) enable aggressive KV eviction (kv_evict_threshold=0.7) on gpu-pool-7, 3) scale pool + cordon/drain noisy node. Will run canary for routing change.
maria: I'll flip eviction and scale +2 GPUs now. Doing step 2.
sam: routing patch ready. Can run canary at 10% traffic.
eric: push canary now and monitor tokenized latencies.
incident-bot: deploy-bot: routing change deployed to canary (10%) — rollout id d-202345.
sam: canary metrics: 10% traffic shows 0.3% 5xx vs 2.1% baseline. Good signal.
leo: hold 5m, then full rollout if stable.
alyssa: support message ready: "We've identified GPU memory pressure causing transient OOMs for long-context requests; temporary throttle to long requests and pool scaling are in place. We'll update in 10 mins." Approve to send?
eric: send now.
pagerduty-bot: PD-8492 status: acknowledged by eric. Escalation suppressed.
maria: scaling started, but gpu-7-3 has repeated cgroup OOMs on container inference-runtime. I'm cordoning and draining it.
sam: cordon/drain command in progress: `kubectl drain gpu-7-3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`
maria: drain complete, restarted inference pod on gpu-7-4. Monitoring.
sam: after draining gpu-7-3, OOM events in the pool dropped by ~70%.
leo: good. Follow-ups for postmortem: allocator traces, kv cache hit rate history, request size distribution, core dump (gpu-7-3), any recent quantization/runtime changes.
alyssa: opening incident ticket INC-2023-071 and linking PD + support tickets.
eric: recommend follow-ups: short-term: keep eviction aggressive and routing limits for 24h; medium-term: add per-request memory estimation and automatic fallback to lower-precision path. Assign eng-runtime + eng-ml.
maria: assigning to eng-runtime (sam) and eng-ml (leo).
sam: grabbing allocator traces and will upload to incident doc (INC-2023-071).
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: PD-8492 marked resolved — no active OOM alerts for 15m. Incident archived. https://pagerduty.example/PD-8492
alyssa: closing thread here. Postmortem review scheduled tomorrow 10:00 PT. Thanks all for fast triage.
